sim.long-description: Rough Seminole for MGA's multi-engine stage. Seneca II cockpit and body with a Seminole T-tail; the flight model is the Seneca's resized to the Seminole: 183.8 sq ft wing, 2450 lb empty, 3800 lb gross, two 180 hp Lycoming O-360s with counter-rotating 74 in feathering props. Offline check: about 155 KTAS at 78% power at 5500 ft, about 1,050 fpm on two engines and 230 fpm on one (feathered) at gross.
